limitations: No full data-layer repository run or 50-rule complete-corpus CPU result in this experiment.
Native broader run has 10 environment failures; it is not an all-green suite.
Timing compiler configuration is opt-level 1 with no LTO and a system allocator shim; these are matched experimental controls, not package-release timings.
Generated-template identities classify only compiler-owned SQL. They are not an identity scheme for arbitrary authored SQL or durable cross-version caches.
Sparse child and span demands retain dependency order; this work does not combine every independent sparse scope into one preparation statement.
Cross-batch layout CPU includes SQL setup and cache construction, but excludes earlier file publication/preparation and final matcher; do not report it as end-to-end speed.
External samples are short mixed-phase active-stack samples; percentages are not exact process CPU attribution.
The absolute 30% and 10% improvement targets were missed.
Broader catalog retirement, utility-definition replacement, retention eviction and durable cache APIs are unpromoted proposals because the storage experiments regress.
